metadata.name: OpenAI Compatible Translate
metadata.author: paparei
metadata.description: Translate through 9router's OpenAI-compatible API. Configure your API key and exact 9router model; the endpoint defaults to https://ai.lts.asia/v1.

api_url.title: Chat Completions URL
api_url.subtitle: Your 9router base URL. Use https://ai.lts.asia/v1 or another OpenAI-compatible base ending in /v1.

api_key.title: 9router API key
api_key.subtitle: Required by https://ai.lts.asia and sent only as Authorization: Bearer.

model.title: Model
model.subtitle: Required: use the exact model name exposed by your 9router.

glossary.title: Names and terminology glossary
glossary.subtitle: Optional, one preferred translation per line, for example 张三 = Trương Tam.

system_prompt.title: Extra translation instructions
system_prompt.subtitle: Optional instructions appended to the default translation rules.
